feature: Unify the letter display cards across all consonant chapters, including inline IPA, example reading, mnemonic illustration and caption, and articulation tip.
changes: Use one shared selected-letter card layout for b/p/m/f, d/t/n/l, g/k/h, j/q/x, zh/ch/sh/r, and z/c/s.
Put the consonant and its IPA on the same row in every consonant chapter.
Move the selected letter’s mnemonic illustration and word caption into the letter card, and remove the duplicate lower focus row.
Keep the example reading and articulation tip inside the same card with wrapping and phone-width spacing.
unchanged: Audio, recording, course navigation, quizzes, progression, and unlock behavior.
